comments.body: `roundCents(1.005)` returns `1`, not `1.01`: `1.005 * 100` is `100.49999999999999` in IEEE-754 double precision, so `Math.round` rounds down. Invoice totals that end in a half cent will be under-billed. Compensate for the representation error before rounding, for example with `Number.EPSILON` or by rounding in exponent notation.
comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
